label: Version 1.3.9
releaseNotes: Protects source and existing output files with separate-folder validation, isolated staging, and collision-safe publishing.
Stops the full batch before packaging or upload when any referral source fails schema or processing validation.
Adds a safety review showing the workflow, source, output behavior, archive, station plan, and upload destinations before every run.
Creates a versioned batch manifest with counts, Referral Number uniqueness, station distribution, source and archive SHA-256 hashes, and upload outcomes.
Adds recent-run history, Open Output Folder, View Batch Manifest, Copy Output Path, and retry-only-failed-upload actions.
Adds named generation presets that preserve reusable business settings without saving folders or upload credentials.
Uses backend-authoritative environment policy and requires typed PROD confirmation for LEIE production uploads.
Uses structured progress phases, safe cancellation messaging, stronger Windows E2E coverage, and modular safety, policy, validation, history, and review components.
